moves.name: Body Feint
moves.description: A quick shoulder drop to fake a direction change. The most fundamental skill move in football.
moves.whenToUse: Approaching a defender 1v1 — sell the feint then exit the opposite way.

moves.name: Ball Roll
moves.description: Roll the ball laterally with the sole of the boot. Keeps possession while shifting the ball away from pressure.
moves.whenToUse: When a defender lunges in — roll away to create a passing lane or shot angle.

moves.name: Fake Shot
moves.description: Charge a shot or cross then cancel with a pass button. Freezes defenders and goalkeepers.
moves.whenToUse: Inside the box to send the keeper the wrong way, or outside to cut inside.

moves.name: Drag Back
moves.description: Drag the ball backwards while facing forward. Classic escape move under pressure.
moves.whenToUse: When receiving a pass with a defender tight on your back — drag away to create space.

moves.name: Step Over
moves.description: The iconic step over — circle the foot around the ball to unbalance the defender.
moves.whenToUse: 1v1 on the wing, mix with body feints to keep the fullback guessing.

moves.name: Stop and Turn
moves.description: Stop the ball dead then explode 90 degrees. Also known as the 'fake stop'.
moves.whenToUse: Sprinting down the wing — fake a cross, stop, and cut inside.

moves.name: Heel to Heel
moves.description: Tap the ball forward with the heel then push it with the other foot. Great for tight spaces.
moves.whenToUse: When double-teamed — heel-to-heel bursts you through the gap.

moves.name: Ball Roll Fake
moves.description: Start a ball roll one way, then quickly reverse. A deceptive two-touch move.
moves.whenToUse: Edge of the box — fake the roll to shoot then roll the other way and finesse.

moves.name: Roulette
moves.description: The Marseille Roulette — a full 360° spin that shields the ball. Zidane's signature move.
moves.whenToUse: When a defender charges directly at you — spin around them and burst into space.

moves.name: Berba Spin
moves.description: Flick forward then exit 90 degrees. A quicker, tighter version of the roulette.
moves.whenToUse: Cutting inside from the wing — Berba spin freezes the fullback.

moves.name: Heel Chop
moves.displayControls: Hold L2 + RS ← then R1 (quick chop)
moves.description: Chop the ball behind the standing leg at a sharp angle. Ronaldo's favourite cut.
moves.whenToUse: Running at pace — heel chop creates an instant 90° change that few defenders read.

moves.name: Scoop Turn
moves.description: A stylish 180° turn that scoops the ball in a half-circle behind you.
moves.whenToUse: Facing your own goal with a defender behind — scoop turn to face forward instantly.

moves.name: Bolasie Flick
moves.description: Flick the ball up and behind you. Named after Yannick Bolasie — pure flair.
moves.whenToUse: When a defender is right on your back — flick it over both of you and chase.

moves.name: Double Touch
moves.description: A rapid two-touch shift that sends the ball diagonally. Extremely effective in tight dribbling.
moves.whenToUse: Inside the box to create a split-second shooting angle.

moves.name: Elastico
moves.displayControls: RS → then roll down to ← (sweep motion)
moves.description: The famous elastico/flip-flap — Ronaldinho's trademark. Ball sticks to the outside then flicks inside.
moves.whenToUse: 1v1 vs last defender — elastico leaves them planted while you glide past.

moves.name: Reverse Elastico
moves.displayControls: RS ← then roll down to → (reverse sweep)
moves.description: The mirror of the elastico — starts inside then flicks outside. Even more deceptive.
moves.whenToUse: When the defender expects the elastico — reverse elastico beats the read.

moves.name: McGeady Spin
moves.description: Flick forward then rotate the back foot around the ball. Named after Aiden McGeady.
moves.whenToUse: On the wing, turning infield at pace — McGeady spin is faster than a Berba spin.

moves.name: Rainbow Flick
moves.description: Flick the ball up and over your head with both feet. Pure showboating when it comes off.
moves.whenToUse: When a defender charges in low — rainbow it over them and volley.

moves.name: Sombrero Flick
moves.description: A stationary rainbow — pops the ball straight up for a volley or header.
moves.whenToUse: When receiving a lobbed pass under pressure — sombrero sets up a bicycle kick.

moves.name: Fake Rabona
moves.description: A rabona fake shot — wraps the kicking leg behind the standing leg then cancels. Freezes everyone.
moves.whenToUse: Cutting inside from the wing — fake rabona sets up an unstoppable finesse shot.

moves.name: Drag to Heel
moves.description: Drag the ball back then flick it forward with the heel. A sharp, sudden burst move.
moves.whenToUse: When double-teamed in midfield — drag to heel nutmegs the first defender.

moves.name: Three Touch Roulette
moves.description: A tighter, quicker roulette that uses three touches instead of a full spin. Unpredictable exit.
moves.whenToUse: In the penalty box with multiple defenders — three-touch roulette finds the gap.

moves.name: Advanced Rainbow
moves.description: The advanced rainbow — higher arc, more power, lands further ahead. Neymar's signature flick.
moves.whenToUse: When a defender is 2-3 metres away and charging — advanced rainbow clears them cleanly.

moves.name: Waka Waka
moves.displayControls: RS → then sweep down to ← (like elastico, different rhythm)
moves.description: A variant of the elastico with a distinct rhythm — the ball almost dances. Popularised in street football.
moves.whenToUse: Showboating 1v1 — the Waka Waka is style points and genuinely effective against aggressive defenders.

moves.name: Tornado Spin
moves.description: A rapid 360° spin initiated by three quick forward flicks. The player tornadoes past the defender.
moves.whenToUse: When you need to beat a defender and create a passing angle simultaneously.

moves.name: Elastico Chop
moves.displayControls: Elastico start then L2 chop exit
moves.description: Start an elastico then chop the ball at a right angle halfway through. Two moves in one.
moves.whenToUse: Against a defender who reads the standard elastico — the chop exit beats them on the second move.

moves.name: Flair Nutmeg
moves.description: A cheeky nutmeg with extra animation flair. The ball slides between the defender's legs with style.
moves.whenToUse: When a defender over-commits — flair nutmeg is the ultimate humiliation and effective exit.

moves.name: Bridge
moves.description: Knock the ball past one side of the defender and run around the other. Simple, devastating.
moves.whenToUse: When you have a pace advantage — bridge sends the ball one way while you run the other.

moves.name: Flair Pass
moves.description: Adds a flashy animation to a standard pass. Backheels, no-look passes, and scoops.
moves.whenToUse: Anytime you want style points on a simple pass — just hold L2.

moves.name: Lane Change
moves.description: A subtle lateral shift that opens the body for a shot or cross. The pro player's favourite setup touch.
moves.whenToUse: Before shooting — lane change creates the perfect angle for a far-post finesse.

sequences.name: Classic Wing Combo
sequences.description: The bread-and-butter wing combo. Step over to freeze the fullback, ball roll to shift inside, fake shot to wrong-foot the keeper.

sequences.name: Spin Cycle
sequences.description: Feint one way, roulette through the press, scoop turn to face goal. A midfield destroyer combo.

sequences.name: Box Creator
sequences.description: Create shooting space in tight areas. Roll away, drag back to reset, heel-to-heel burst into the shot.

sequences.name: Flair God
sequences.description: The ultimate showboat chain. Elastico, immediate reverse, then McGeady spin to exit. Defenders get sent to the shadow realm.

sequences.name: Stop & Pop
sequences.description: Sprint down the wing, fake the cross with a stop-turn, fake the shot, step over and cross for real. Unreadable.

sequences.name: Chop & Flick
sequences.description: Chop inside, roll to set up, advanced rainbow over the charging CB. Only for the brave.

sequences.name: Trickster's Exit
sequences.description: Double touch past the first man, Berba spin past the second, fake rabona to freeze the keeper. Goal guaranteed.

sequences.name: Aerial Assault
sequences.description: Bridge past one defender, sombrero flick over the second, tornado spin to lose the third. Practically a cheat code.

sequences.name: Nutmeg Rush
sequences.description: Drag to heel for the nutmeg, Waka Waka to dance away, Bolasie flick for the highlight reel finish.

sequences.name: Warmup Routine
sequences.description: The perfect warmup chain. Practice these four fundamentals in sequence before every session to build muscle memory.
